phrases.text: There are only five landmarks on the Fortnite map. Here's every single one.
First, The Salty Skull, in the east, closest to Cursed Cavern.
Then Baratie, in the south-east, closest to Busy Bay.
Next, Henry, in the south-east, closest to Plunder Port.
After that, Giant's Battlefield, near the center, closest to Loguetown.
And last, Nami's Tangerine Grove, in the south-west, closest to Windmill Village.
Which one have you found? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
